chordal_by_cycles.note: chordal_by_cycles G: every chordless genuine cycle (chordless_cycle: ucycle, 2 < size c, no chord) has at most three vertices; equivalent to the absence of holes (chordal_by_cyclesP); true on graphs with at most three vertices; K_3's triangle is accepted.

clique_tree_decomposition.note: clique_tree_decomposition bag: tree_bag_decomposition bag (is_tree [set: T], vertex and edge coverage, connected fibres) and cliqueb (bag t) for every index t; no maximality, injectivity or nonempty-bag requirement.

admits_clique_tree.note: admits_clique_tree G: some supplied index graph and bag map form a clique_tree_decomposition; K_0 uses the empty index, a complete host one full bag on K_1; not identified with chordal_by_cycles.
